title: Masala Corn Cup
description: Steamed sweet corn kernels tossed with butter, chaat masala and lemon, a quick mall-style snack made at home.
steps: Steam the corn kernels, or boil them in salted water, for 6 to 8 minutes until tender.
Drain well and return them to the pan with the butter on low heat.
Add the chaat masala, red chilli powder and salt and toss for 1 minute.
Take off the heat, add the lemon juice and coriander leaves and serve in cups.
